task.description: WF-03 Step 0.5 (registry lookup: docs/issues/*.yaml resolved entries about service tasks / request_build_error / seeding, e.g. ISS-0897, ISS-0893) + Step 1 (diagnose), combined. Defect D1 (BLOCKER): on QA (https://qa.bizdala.com) meridian/vortex definitions seeded by scripts/seed_meridian_definition.sh and scripts/seed_vortex_definition.sh (payload fixtures test/fixtures/simulation/meridian/process_claim_intake.yaml -> test/fixtures/qa/meridian_loan_origination_process_definition.json etc.) have service-task nodes (POST /kyc/screen at kyc-aml-check; /mes/.../quarantine at quarantine-batch; /mes/.../assign at assign-line) that fail with request_build_error (instances ERROR, error_detail service_task_retries_exhausted, last_failure_kind request_build_error). Find the ROOT CAUSE: read lib/letflow/engine/service_task.ex, the dispatcher/http transport (lib/letflow/engine/ service_task_dispatcher*, the :target_url_not_allowed / URL allow-list / base_url resolution path, design docs lib/letflow/design/service_task*.md) and the seeded node configs; determine which {:request_build_error, reason} reason is produced and why (e.g. relative path with no base URL, target_url_not_allowed allowlist, missing connector/service config). Decide whether the fix belongs in the seed definition (fixtures/seed scripts), the engine, or both. REPRODUCE: (a) locally by reproducing the seeded node config through the engine/transport in a test or mix run (b) on real QA read-only: get a token with `bash /c/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/ai-dala-infra/scripts/qa-uat-env.sh token meridian-admin-user` (prints a BARE JWT; capture in a shell variable only; NEVER print it, never write it to any file or your handoff) and GET the definition JSON from https://qa.bizdala.com/api/v1/definitions to read the deployed service-task node config; you may ssh per qa-uat-env.sh if you need server-side config/env (e.g. allowed-hosts env vars) but never print secrets. Do not create test instances in this step unless essential (if you do, cancel them). Do NOT implement the fix. Work ONLY in the worktree given in context.worktree (never the main checkout C:/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/letflow-4). Do not commit; ORCH commits. Fill result in this handoff file; set status IN_PROGRESS at claim, then COMPLETED/FAILED at end with result.status PASS/FAIL. result.summary must give root cause with line citations, the reason term observed, affected files, recommended fix location (seed vs engine vs both), and whether a real mix-test regression test is feasible (engine fix) or only a fixture/seed contract test (seed fix). Also list owned_modules the fix will write. next_action: 'Route to CODE-DESIGNER for fix design'.

result.summary:
REGISTRY LOOKUP: docs/issues searched. ISS-0897 (resolved) delivered the meridian/vortex seed scripts and fixtures but only verified they seed/start, never that service tasks execute; ISS-0893 (swiftroute key null) is unrelated. No prior entry for request_build_error / service-task endpoint format, so this is NOT a recurrence of a held fix; it is the first occurrence of a defect in the seed contract ISS-0897 created.

OBSERVED REASON TERM: {:request_build_error, :target_url_not_allowed} (raw_outcome), classified to failure_kind :request_build_error (lib/letflow/engine/service_task.ex:343), non-retriable (service_task.ex:382) -> immediate give_up -> error_type :service_task_retries_exhausted, reason 'service task failed (request_build_error): not retriable' (service_task.ex:465-476). Matches UAT evidence (error_detail service_task_retries_exhausted, last_failure_kind request_build_error, 'not retriable').

ROOT CAUSE (seed/contract mismatch, confirmed by code trace plus live QA config; the engine behaves per its documented design):
1. Every seeded SERVICE_TASK node has attributes.endpoint = '<METHOD> <relative path>', e.g. "POST /kyc/screen", "POST /mes/batches/{batch_ref}/quarantine", "POST /mes/orders/{order_id}/assign" (test/fixtures/qa/*.json; 20 distinct endpoint strings across the 5 QA fixtures; none is an absolute URL, none sets service_id or method).
2. The engine does NOT parse 'METHOD path' and has no base URL. ServiceTask.parse_config_from_node_attributes/1 (lib/letflow/engine/service_task.ex:185-222) takes the whole string verbatim as url_template (line 193 ref_id(attrs,"endpoint")), route_kind :inline_url (line 200); method is read only from a separate "method" attribute and defaults to :POST (lines 169, 234-237).
3. Engine.resolve_service_task_arm_attrs (lib/letflow/engine.ex:898-904) renders only {{variables.KEY}} tokens (render_service_task_url, engine.ex:962-968; the seeds use single-brace {application_id}/{batch_ref}/{order_id}, which are NOT rendered) and freezes rendered_url = "POST /kyc/screen" into config_snapshot (engine.ex:936-946). validate_rendered_url/1 (service_task.ex:301-307) only rejects empty, so arming succeeds and the dispatch row is created (why the instance starts, then errors ~3s later at the first poller attempt).
4. ServiceTaskDispatcher.do_attempt_dispatch (service_task_dispatcher.ex:739-753) calls http_transport/3 (310-317) -> UrlValidator.validate/2 (lib/letflow/webhooks/url_validator.ex:43-49). URI.parse("POST /kyc/screen") gives scheme: nil, host: nil, path: "POST /kyc/screen" (verified with elixir -e). check_scheme/1 (url_validator.ex:97-98) accepts only scheme "https" -> {:error,:target_url_not_allowed} -> mapped to {:request_build_error, :target_url_not_allowed} at service_task_dispatcher.ex:337-339. :httpc is never reached. Identical path for kyc-aml-check, assign-line, quarantine-batch and every other seeded service task (timeout/flag/notify nodes) that would run later.
5. Why tests did not catch it: service_task_dispatcher_test / service_task_test use absolute URLs with SSRF flag off or an injected resolver; no test feeds a seed-fixture endpoint through parse -> render -> validate; CHK-10 (graph.ex:803-817) only checks endpoint is non-blank.

EVIDENCE FROM REAL QA (read-only GET /api/v1/definitions/{id}; token held in a shell variable only, never printed or persisted): Loan Origination (id 29c96786-b8ae-4453-90c0-ffb3519ac0cc) deployed SERVICE_TASK nodes: {"id":"kyc-aml-check","attributes":{"endpoint":"POST /kyc/screen","timeout_ms":300000}}; create-facility endpoint "POST /core-banking/facilities"; decline-application "POST /crm/applications/{application_id}/decline"; four timeout nodes "POST /internal/applications/{application_id}/flag". No "method", no "service_id", no absolute URL: identical to the fixture. No test instances created; no ssh needed.

LOCAL REPRO LIMITATION: the worktree has no fetched deps (mix run fails 'dependency is not available, run mix deps.get'); I did not run deps.get. The URI.parse behavior was reproduced with plain elixir; the rest is traced by code reading and confirmed by live QA behavior and the deployed config. The fix stage must run mix deps.get in the worktree before mix test.

SECOND-ORDER FINDINGS the fix design MUST handle (otherwise fixing the format only moves the failure):
(a) The SSRF gate (url_validator.ex:97-102 plus IP-literal/DNS checks) requires https and a host resolving to non-private, non-loopback addresses; there is no allow-list and no base_url setting in config. Any target must be a public https host. None of /kyc/screen, /mes/*, /core-banking/*, /crm/*, /internal/*, /webhooks/* exists as a service on QA.
(b) Single-brace {placeholder} tokens are not rendered (only {{variables.KEY}}, engine.ex:965); they would be sent literally.
(c) A target must return 2xx with a JSON object body (service_task.ex:345-349, 361-366) else :invalid_2xx_body; keys merge into instance variables.

RECOMMENDED FIX LOCATION: SEED (fixtures + seed scripts), NOT an engine change. Reasoning: the engine contract (lib/letflow/design/service_task.md section 5.1 table, ~line 414) defines endpoint as an absolute URL template; the https-only SSRF gate is an INV-9 BLOCKER security invariant that must not be loosened; a 'METHOD path' + base_url convention in the engine is a new feature needing a decision record, REVIEWER and SECURITY-REVIEWER sign-off, out of proportion for a seed defect. Recommended design: rewrite each seeded endpoint to an absolute https URL on a public mock host, set "method":"POST" explicitly, convert {x} to {{variables.x}}; parameterise the host in the seed scripts (e.g. env SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_BASE substituted via jq at seed time) and provide/identify a public-https mock returning 200 + JSON object. Engine alternative (only if product wants relative endpoints): add 'METHOD path' parsing + configured allow-listed base_url in parse_config_from_node_attributes/Engine render, with an ADR; treat as out of scope unless the mock-host option is rejected. The seed scripts are idempotent and skip when an ACTIVE definition exists (seed_meridian_definition.sh existing_id branch), so the design must also cover replacing the already-ACTIVE QA definitions (new version or delete+reseed).

REGRESSION TEST FEASIBILITY: since the fix is seed-side, a real ExUnit test is feasible and recommended as a fixture/seed CONTRACT test (no DB, no network): for every SERVICE_TASK node in test/fixtures/qa/*_process_definition.json (after placeholder substitution) assert (1) ServiceTask.parse_config_from_node_attributes/1 succeeds with valid method, (2) the rendered URL passes UrlValidator.validate/2 with an injected public-IP resolver (https + host), (3) no unrendered single-brace tokens remain. It fails today (scheme nil). A true engine-level mix regression applies only if the engine alternative is chosen (tests in test/letflow/engine/service_task_test.exs and service_task_dispatcher_test.exs).

AFFECTED FILES: test/fixtures/qa/meridian_loan_origination_process_definition.json, meridian_regulatory_compliance_review_process_definition.json, vortex_production_order_release_process_definition.json, vortex_supplier_quality_deviation_process_definition.json, swiftroute_process_definition.json (same latent defect); scripts/seed_meridian_definition.sh, seed_vortex_definition.sh, seed_swiftroute_definition.sh; simulation yaml sources test/fixtures/simulation/meridian/*.yaml; docs/issues/ISS-0930.yaml. Read but NOT to change: lib/letflow/engine/service_task.ex, service_task_dispatcher.ex, engine.ex, lib/letflow/webhooks/url_validator.ex.

Note: D2 (role groups), D3, D4 are separate defects, not addressed here.
